gz.what: free Gaussian g(z, t) per energy and frame, [re, im]

method: Strang split-step Fourier, 2D; psi = phi(x, y) g(z); hard column by setting psi = 0 inside after every step
units: hbar = m = 1, lengths in the grid unit a

source.what: files copied byte for byte from the notebook output; SHA-256 as Kaggle wrote them

check.dt_convergence: E = 2, R = 4, end of run: finite V0 = 3, dt 0.0025 -> 0.00125 changes ahead by 3e-7; hard column, dt 0.0005 -> 0.00025 changes ahead by 9e-5, behind by 8e-4, norm by 1e-3 (the step 0.005 and 0.001 runs end at a different time and are not comparable)
check.lost: the wave scattered sideways reaches the border at |y| ~ 26 and is absorbed: up to 26 % in some runs, shown as lost
